headline: End of Session I, IHSG Closes Up 0.39% at 5,341
summary: The Jakarta Composite Index closed up 0.39% at 5,341.61. The article cites global and domestic economic sentiment as factors behind the move.
why: The Jakarta Composite Index tracks stocks listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, the main equity benchmark for Indonesia's market.

impacts.name: Jakarta Composite Index
impacts.why: The index closed up 0.39%, and it directly reflects the prices of Indonesian listed stocks.
